name: ANSI/IEEE power transformer symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for power transformer, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The power-transformer form identifies magnetically coupled winding circuits supplying power. Its winding ratings and connection designations explain the electrical relationship; the drawing outline alone does not establish vector group, insulation rating or installation dimensions.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Identify primary and secondary circuit boundaries separately.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A power transformer and a voltage instrument transformer may share visual features while serving different circuit duties.
